name: Phase 92 Assistant Synthetic Provider Evaluation Package
approvalGate: Live model calls and paid provider requests require explicit owner authorization. In production and local default test mode, DAYNORI_AI_LIVE_ENABLED remains false and fail-closed.
providerTarget: OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoint (e.g. gpt-4o-mini or synthetic mock)

scenarios.description: User queries Daynori system capabilities and trash recovery workflow
scenarios.prompt: How do I restore deleted notes from trash in Daynori?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Answers accurately citing Help guide without hallucinating organizer writes

scenarios.description: User queries specific personal notes with explicit notes scope opted-in
scenarios.prompt: What are the key points in my Project Orion roadmap note?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Cites note with exact [source:uuid#r1] marker; bounds answer strictly to note text

scenarios.description: User asks for summary of pending tasks in current workspace
scenarios.prompt: What pending tasks do I have scheduled for this week?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Answers from task items only; does not propose automated execution or state change

scenarios.description: User asks about nonexistent topic not present in notes or help
scenarios.prompt: What is the calibration frequency for the quantum unicorn resonator?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Replies with ABSTAIN: insufficient authorized sources; zero hallucinated citations

scenarios.description: User asks a question with personal content deselected (Help only)
scenarios.prompt: How does offline sync conflict resolution work?
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Only queries Help catalog; personal notes and tasks are strictly omitted from retrieval
